description:
List the most popular Spark assets by download count, optionally filtered by type.

For when browsing without a text query; search_assets finds text matches.
Returns numbered summaries with outcomes, price, tags and URLs, or 'No assets
found.' Downloads measure acquisitions, not successful applications or ratings.
Public catalog lookup, no login or download recorded.

For example, list_popular(type='skill', limit=5).

type.description: Optional asset type: agent, skill, prompt, prompt_chain, mcp_connector or bundle; omitted means all types.

name: list_popular
title: List popular assets
